step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an L - Bill C-15/C-50 extended benefits BP extension with a start date of July 3, 2016 (w/c 2037) or less on file:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.
If no, go to step 7.

step.cmd: Click the Benefit Period Extensions link on the Rate/Duration tab to determine how many additional weeks the client is entitled to.
Click the C-15/Job Search link to determine how many additional weeks have been paid.
Determine if all additional weeks of benefits have been paid:

ul.li: If all additional weeks have not been paid, note the number of weeks left. Go to step 7.
If all additional weeks have been paid, the client has exhausted regular entitlement on this claim. Go to step 18.

step.cmd: Note the number of weeks displayed in the Entitlement weeks field on the Summary tab.
Compare the entitlement weeks with the regular weeks paid. Note the number of weeks left of regular benefits to reach entitlement weeks.
To determine the number of maximum combined weeks payable, add 5 to the amount displayed in the Entitlement weeks field on the Summary tab:

ul.li: If the result is 50 or less, the maximum combined weeks payable remains 50.
If the result is 51 or more, note the number of weeks left to reach the new maximum combined weeks payable.

step.cmd: Note the number of combined week of benefits left to be paid by subtracting 50 from the new combined weeks of benefits payable.
Determine the end date of the L - Bill C-15/C-50 extended benefits BP extension.
Determine and note how many weeks there are until the LRW is reached (BP extension end date - last week processed).
Determine the number of regular weeks still payable on the claim by identifying the lesser of the following:

ul.li: additional weeks still payable (step 6)
regular weeks of entitlement left (step 8)
weeks left to reach the new maximum combined weeks (step 10)
weeks left to reach the LRW (step 12)

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the rejected transaction:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 15.

If no , select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .
Go to step 15.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual pay system .
Work type: Select 50 - Legislative interim measure .
Earnings to be allocated: Complete the weeks and amounts, if required.
Remarks line 1: Type “C286 reject.” Provide the information about the claimant’s report that was rejected (w/c, benefit type and, if applicable, earnings and not available days).
Remarks line 2: Type “NEW LRW [w/c as identified in step 10] ENT WKS [number identified in step 6] MAX COMB WEEKS [number identified in step 8].”
Remarks line 3: Type “CT 2 - Remaining WKS PAYABLE [number identified in step 12].” Note
Remarks line 4: Enter your name and phone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Remove the SIN from the Rejected Transactions Retrieval (MR05) as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the appropriate SIN.
Click Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if a WI exists for the error:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI.
If no , no further action is required.

step.cmd: Return to Searching for rejected transactions by SCC number .
